# `Css`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Css — the typed stylesheet DSL, compiled pure Ipê source.

100% pure Ipê. CSS generation is string building; the only Rust surface is
the leaf security kernels imported from `Ipe.CssSafety` (`safeValue` /
`safePropName` / `safeSelector` / `sanitizeRawBody` / `stripStyleClose`),
which gate every free-string entry point at construction (parse, don't
validate).

`CssProp` and `CssRule` are opaque: the only construction path is through
the gated smart constructors (`property`, `rule`, `media`, `keyframes`,
`raw`). A failing gate yields an explicit dropped state (`CssDropped` /
`CssRuleDropped`) rather than a silent partial emit. `Length` and `Color`
are also opaque — built only via the typed builders (`px`, `rem`, `hex`,
`rgb`, …) — so a rendered declaration is provably post-scan.

The generic escape hatches (`property`, `rawProp`, `colorRaw`, `lengthRaw`,
`raw`) are sanitized at construction and intended only for values that the
typed builders do not cover. Prefer the typed builders for everything that
appears in author-controlled code.
